Owner-relative sides are reversed from the exact final prompt: the sill arm is the pilot anatomical RIGHT (image left), while the map hand is anatomical LEFT (image right). The prompt specified left forearm on sill and right hand on map; intended contact assignment therefore fails.

The pilot, hatch and both machine shoulder junctions are assessable together; the source F13 comparison is visible. However the final reviewed camera clause also required a full near machine leg reaching the ground, and that closest ground endpoint is cropped. Human boots and floor contact are hidden. The full declared projection/support evidence set cannot pass.
